title: Define scheduler, quotas, backpressure and autonomous action budget
purpose: Prevent AgentOS autonomy from becoming unbounded by defining scheduling, retry, quota and action-budget rules.
scope: Extend dependency-aware scheduling into OS control loops.
Define operator escalation when budget is exhausted.
implementation_steps: Define scheduling policy per loop and risk class.
Define metrics for blocked, throttled and exhausted runs.
Record evidence with runaway prevention scenarios.
acceptance_criteria: Read-only loops have bounded resource use.
Backpressure is visible to operator projection.
Budget exhaustion produces suspended or failed-closed state.
failure_modes: Autonomous loops can create infinite retries.
Budget rules are bypassable by planner hints.
